title: Inline photo notes and the rich markdown editor

completion_criteria.text: The four rich-editor audits (prototype editor, app capture/storage, package landscape, single-TextField substrate limits) are complete, cited, and committed under docs/specs/research/
The editor substrate architecture is decided and recorded as a decision record with its rejected alternatives and pre-mortem
A detailed spec covering BOTH the rich markdown editor AND OQ-6 exists, orders the editor strictly before OQ-6, and resolves every unreachable value at spec time
The existing P0-P5 inline-photo ladder has been re-read against the no-wrap-in-EditableText limit and either amended or explicitly re-affirmed
The spec is implemented via mitosis, every MSP leaving note capture working on its own merge commit
No schema migration was required, or one shipped as its own MSP with a successful-upgrade test and a rollback proven on a copy of a real journal

spine.active_goal: Ship the rich markdown editor (E0-E7), then OQ-6's inline anchored photos (P0-P5) -- one controller seam, editor first, no schema migration. The combined spec (docs/specs/2026-08-03-rich-editor-and-inline-photos.md, branch inline-photo/spec, 62da2cb, 834 lines) is the standing AUTHORITY and citation source. NOT DISPATCHABLE: all three convergence reviewers returned BLOCK. Execution slices must be cut from it per decision 0006.
spine.next_step: DO NOT DISPATCH. Convergence pass returned BLOCK x3 (coherence, mitosis-readiness, E0 implementer simulation). Fix order: (1) the two D1 CRITICALs -- logic errors, not wording; (2) recompute the 7.1 overlap matrix, built on a fence D1 invalidated; (3) declare the TYPES; (4) reconcile local main; (5) acceptance criteria for E2/E3/E5/E7; (6) cut the E0+P0+P1 slice per decision 0006. Consider RE-CUTTING the spec rather than patching -- it has now been patched six times.
open_risks: CRITICAL D1 LOGIC ERROR: rendersEmpty declares a divider-only note EMPTY -- '---' renders (grammar row 8) but has no plain text. Read view would show 'Empty note' over a rendered rule; composer would refuse to save it. Fix: blocks.isEmpty || (no renderable block && plainText empty).
CRITICAL D1 FENCE VIOLATION: D1 assigns the save-guard swap at text_composer_sheet.dart:186 to E3, but 3.2's E3 row forbids that file. Exactly the unfenced-file failure 3.2 exists to prevent.

THE 7.1 OVERLAP MATRIX IS WRONG: it lists text_composer_sheet.dart's E phases as E2/E5/E6, computed against a fence D1 had already invalidated by adding E3. Recompute before trusting any ship-order claim from it.

NO TYPES ANYWHERE. MarkdownBlock is named once in 834 lines, never defined; no function signature declared. All 14 phases consume the model. An E0 implementer simulation could not ship from the spec alone.

A9 gives P0 a compile-time import of E0 files that E1 git-mv's to lib/design/markdown/, and 7.2 orders P0 BEFORE E1. On E1's merge commit P0's imports break. A build break yields zero tests, not a reduced count.
UNDERLINE SURVIVES IN THREE PLACES after 3.1 dropped it: E2's style-family list, E5's heading, and 8's manual pass telling a human to verify Cmd+U. E2's '4 cases' arithmetic no longer adds up.
SECTION 10 IS FALSIFIED BASE TEXT, in the section headed 'read before dispatching': 10.1 says never critic-hardened while 11 says closed; 10.6 orders ratifying an already-accepted decision.

A4's deletion anchors are off by four (:616/:890 should be :620/:894); :616 is the note_body.dart row, so a literal reader deletes the WRONG entry. Falsifies 0.2's completeness claim -- in-spec cross-refs were never checked.

DUPLICATED AUTHORITY, unstruck: A8 asserts R0 is spent while A12 reverses it; section 2 asserts 'no phase changes its outcome' while D7 corrects it; A9 supersedes a section 7 sentence that no longer exists.
TEST ARITHMETIC DISAGREES: A7 and 8 say the sibling's deltas stand, but D5 changes P2 +11 to +15 and D2 makes E7 +3 to +6 if E6 drops. 8's '+32' and E7's '3 cases' carry neither.
E0's test count is self-contradictory: 3.1 implies 36 cases (12 rows x 3 criteria), 6 and 8 say 6.
toPlainText() defaults unstated and load-bearing: includeSemanticsLabels defaults TRUE, so D4/E2 semantics suppression could make N1's whole char-for-char gate VACUOUS.
E2, E3, E5, E7 have NO acceptance criteria. E0's created files are never NAMED though E1 depends on them by name. Criterion 2's '200 generated documents' has no seed or determinism clause.
Local main is 30 commits BEHIND origin/main, which is NOT its ancestor. Mitosis cuts worktrees from the bare LOCAL main ref. Gate on git merge-base --is-ancestor origin/main main.
Human-gated merge parks every transitive dependent and 7.2 is a near-linear 14-rung chain -- expect ~12 merge-and-relaunch cycles. Batch-scope it. The spec is also on no base branch.
out_of_scope: OQ-3 (entry-card Edit/Delete placement) — deliberately set aside by the user; still the last open criterion of the separate prototype-design-alignment thread.
Nested lists and indent, links, and custom undo/redo beyond Flutter's built-in UndoHistory — none exist in the prototype to reference.
Any editor package: super_editor, flutter_quill, appflowy_editor, re_editor and flutter_markdown are all rejected on named constraints.
Any database migration or schema change.
Editable text that wraps around an inline object — structurally impossible in Flutter; write mode stays plain.
Arbitrary pixel positioning of photos. The anchor is a position in the text, never an (x, y).
